 Upcoming 1 Sep 2026

...

Cloudflare AI Gateway adds prepaid credits billing for Workers AI and raises frontier model rate limits

...

AI Gateway now uses one credit balance for Workers AI and supported third-party model providers. Prepaid credits also unlock Workers AI frontier models without the Workers Paid plan, and those models get 50 requests per minute per account per model when billed with AI Gateway credits, versus 20 requests per minute through standard Workers AI billing.
